market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-neutral. Third consecutive losing day on equities driven by oil-driven inflation fears and geopolitical risk. Gold above $4,400 signals risk-off. Oracle earnings next week and BOJ holiday intervention are key swing factors. Expect elevated volatility in FX (JPY) and energy. EM credit spreads likely to widen further.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. AI capex cycle (ByteDance $30B, Nvidia $14B) supports tech earnings through 2027. Structural energy demand from AI and EV transition (Range Rover electric) creates durable themes. Japan's rate normalization and GPIF reallocation could drive global capital flows. Inflation risk from oil/tariffs is the primary threat to the growth narrative.
